feedback: The machine is a faithful and safe encoding of the recurring silencing task. The u0<->u1 cycle captures the repeated obligation: (u0, siren_ringing) -> u1 fires on each ring onset, and (u1, switch_toggled & !siren_ringing) -> u0 (+0.1) fires exactly on a toggle that leaves the siren silent — since the siren stops only via a toggle and labels are read post-step, this is precisely a successful silencing, and it recurs for every subsequent ring (the explicit recovery/regression the task requires). The u1 trap is correct: if any ring goes unhandled the machine can never reach u2, so the exit reward is withheld; conversely, being in u0 at the exit step is equivalent to the environment's siren-silent payment condition (an active ring at exit forces u1, and the siren cannot start on the exit step), so there is no paid-but-failed or failed-but-payable mismatch. The terminal transition (u0, at_exit & !siren_ringing) -> u2 (+1.0) is reachable (cf. the example trace: ring -> u1, toggle -> u0 +0.1, exit -> u2 +1.0) and handles the no-siren setup vacuously. Reward safety: no penalty on the uncontrollable ring onset (correct — the agent cannot prevent it), no reward for toggling a silent siren (absorbed by the u0 else self-loop, so no farming), and silencing rewards are bounded at <= 2 because the schedule allows at most two starts, giving a total cap of 1.2. Irrelevant events (holding_box, box_fell, movement, silent toggles) are covered by per-state else self-loops with zero reward. The rare coincidence where a silencing toggle is followed by the second ring start on the same step correctly leaves the machine in u1 (the siren is ringing post-step); the 'swallowed' 0.1 there is a benign shaping imprecision, not a correctness error, and the obligation remains enforced. Persistent/event distinctions are respected: switch_toggled appears only conjoined with the post-step condition, siren_ringing is used as a condition guard. Format matches the paper template exactly: declared states, nonempty FINAL_STATES (u2, declared and accepting for the task), consistent transition/reward triples, predicate-only guards, exhaustive and mutually exclusive guard coverage per state.
